about_the_game:
MR FLESH FLAM is a single player first person chapter based horror game. The gameplay consists of escaping life or death situations; what is the cause of these situations you ask?

There will be many different threats during the chapters. All of these monsters are dramatized versions of characters from the YouTube channel "Flamingo".

The story of MR FLESH FLAM will be revealed over time throughout chapters. For the most part, our story follows Albert. He is an adult in his mid 20s, living alone in his cozy home. He also just so happens to own a YouTube channel where he plays games; and in these games he creates certain characters. Will his choices of certain quirks of these characters come back to bite him? How will he stop these blood thirsty BEASTS! Are they even beasts?! Find out in MR FLESH FLAM. that was a pretty cool paragraph right

MR FLESH FLAM will most likely cost money... I'm so sorry... I CAN ASSURE YOU, it will be a worthy purchase!! There will be around 7 full chapters, each with a unique gameplay quirk aswell as new characters, FREE DLC, an original soundtrack too?!?! Wow! This sounds too good to be true. What's the catch? There is none! The game would be a one time purchase, with everything else in the game being free, so if there is a new chapter release, you won't have to pay any cost.

As for a release date, I am not entirely sure. I am a solo dev with only one other person composing the music for the game, however I will update this section as soon as I can to let you guys know when the game will release.
